auth.loginLead: Log in with your club account to take the quiz.
auth.createAccount: Create an account on the club site

qcm.title: Induction quiz
qcm.intro: {{count}} questions, one at a time. You need at least {{pass}} correct answers.
qcm.ruleLive: The monitoring room watches your progress live.
qcm.ruleCamera: Camera and microphone stay on for the whole quiz.
qcm.ruleScreen: Share your entire screen (the whole display), not a single window.
qcm.ruleStay: Stay on this screen until the end. Switching windows or closing the tab is reported to the proctor.
qcm.ruleScore: You will not see how many answers are correct on this screen. The mark comes by email.
qcm.stayHint: Fullscreen is required. Do not switch windows or close this tab.
qcm.awayLead: The proctor has been notified. Click to go back to fullscreen. Do not leave this window again.
qcm.closed: The quiz is not open right now.
qcm.appointmentLink: This personal link stays valid until you finish the exam. You can keep it open. The proctor will let you start when the session opens.
qcm.appointmentOpen: Convened for {{date}}. This link stays valid until you finish.
qcm.unknown: This link does not match any quiz.
qcm.notInvited: You are not invited to this quiz. Open the personal link from your email, with that same account.
qcm.inviteMismatch: This link belongs to another email address. Log in with the invited account.
qcm.doneLead: The club will email your mark after the session.
qcm.waitingSend: The examiner will email your mark. It is not shown on this screen.
qcm.screenWait: In the browser prompt, choose the entire screen, not a window or a tab.
qcm.screenLost: Screen sharing stopped. Share it again to continue.
qcm.cameraWait: Allow the camera and microphone to continue.
qcm.cameraDenied: Camera or microphone was blocked. Allow them in the browser, then reload.

errors.apiDown: The API is not reachable. Restart the backend server, then try again.

pwa.installText: Add the quiz to your home screen so it fits like an app on your phone.
pwa.installIos: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
